$comment: Frontend source mirrors for selector tracing — the explorer's PRIMARY source when your team has repo access. Clones land in vendor/<name>, which is gitignored: these are a read-only mirror of someone else's repo, not content this repo owns. Leave `repos` empty if you have no frontend access; the explorer falls back to manual test cases, then codegen. Refresh with `npm run vendor:refresh`.

repos.$comment: Example. Delete or replace. `sparse` is the decisive field: a monorepo is usually gigabytes, and the explorer only ever needs the UI source. Listing the two or three directories that hold components cuts a clone to tens of megabytes.
repos.name: frontend
